changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind CHECK (kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','DELIVER_FEEDBACK','EDIT_FEEDBACK', 'RETRACT_FEEDBACK','SLACK_POST','PUBLISH_REPORT','CLEANUP_ISSUE')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace CHECK (workspace_id IS NOT NULL OR kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','PUBLISH_REPORT','CLEANUP_ISSUE')); -- Each cleanup that a maintainer does not hold yet becomes its scrub action. It keeps its next attempt, and gives up -- 30 days after the erasure, as the cleanup did. INSERT INTO agent_action (id, kind, lane_key, idempotency_key, state, payload, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT uuidv7(), 'CLEANUP_ISSUE', 'cleanup:' || c.id, 'cleanup:' || c.id, 'ADMITTED', jsonb_build_object('recordId', c.id), 1000, c.next_attempt_at, c.created_at + interval '30 days', clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp() FROM product_feedback_cleanup c WHERE c.manual_since IS NULL; ALTER TABLE product_feedback_cleanup DROP COLUMN next_attempt_at, DROP COLUMN attempts;
